text: Blockchain enabled platforms for setting up private investment funds exert significant pressure on the existing fee structure because they generate competitive gains through fewer cost and time barriers to setting up and running a fund.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Applications and Fee Structure Developments in Private Investment Funds (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2959730

isBasedOn.name: Blockchain Applications and Fee Structure Developments in Private Investment Funds

abstract: Blockchain-enabled platforms for setting up a private investment fund cause significant pressure on the existing fee structure of the private investment fund industry.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: platform models such as Melonport or Drago
fund formation and ongoing portfolio operation
